summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Bubba Pizza Hub MVP. 29/29 pytest cases pass (auth, me/update/password, stores, announcements, templates, checks list/submit/review with role scoping, accounts CRUD + role rules, template layout management). Frontend verified end-to-end on mobile viewport (390x844): sign-in with invalid+valid creds, Company dashboard with 3 quick-action cards and announcements accordion, Checks tab (status/store chips, awaiting badge, Approve button in-row), New Check submit (Daily Temperature Check with bad freezer value increased 'bad' count server-side), Account tab profile save + wrong-current-password rejection, Company Manage: Account Management bottom sheet create/remove account + Template Management layout edit/save. Franchisee role verified: store chips limited to Langwarrin/Croydon, Manage tab visible but Templates card hidden (accounts card shown). Sign out returns to login. Zero console errors across flows. All APIs working as spec; no mocked integrations.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); FastAPI recommends lifespan context manager (non-blocking, just a future-proofing note).

In /api/accounts (POST), when a franchisee creates a Staff/Manager, the backend does not restrict the chosen stores to the franchisee's own stores (only Company role is gated). A franchisee could technically assign a staff/manager to a store outside their scope. Consider validating `stores` ⊆ franchisee.stores on create and update.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed accounts and submit transient checks; accounts are cleaned up via DELETE in the same test. Password change test restores 'password'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_bubba_api.py are reusable regression suite. Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. Public URL comes from frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md; all seeded accounts use password 'password'. Known gap: franchisee can create staff/manager outside their store scope (minor hardening, not blocking).
